records.question: Eric, Ben, and Jack have some money. Eric has $10 less than Ben, and Ben has $9 less than Jack. If Jack has $26, how much money, in dollars, do all 3 of them have in total?
records.response:
If Ben has $9 less than Jack, then Ben has 26-9 = $17.
If Eric has $10 less than Ben, then Eric has 17-10 = $7.
All three of them have 26+17+7 = $50.
#### 50
